summary: Added Encodable, Countable, Infinite, and Denumerable instances to Cslib/Logics/LTL/Syntax/Formula.lean. The plan's deriving Encodable approach failed in the CSLib module context (known handler bug); replaced with a WType-based manual encoding using Encodable.ofLeftInverse. All four instances resolve for Formula ℕ and Infinite resolves for Formula Empty. Zero sorries, no new axioms (only standard propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound). Lake build passes; lint, lint-style, and shake all clean for the modified file.
